shots.detail_en: close-up, FATHER standing at the edge of a rooftop in heavy night rain seen from behind, suit flapping in wind, steel watch chain glinting, dramatic backlight silhouette
shots.sub: 1993 年 6 月 17 日，我父亲教了我最后一课。
shots.speaker: 旁白
shots.fx: 雨声+远处交易大厅嗡鸣

shots.detail_en: medium shot from a boy's low-angle POV, FATHER turning his head back with an unexpected smile, rain-soaked night rooftop, dramatic backlit rim light
shots.sub: 长虹，记住——牛市没有眼泪。
shots.speaker: 父

shots.detail_en: extreme close-up of the broken pocket watch chain snapping, a tie clip falling and landing on the rooftop floor, only the object lands with no person in frame, transitional imagery
extreme wide aerial diving shot over the 港海市 night skyline in the new millennium, neon lights everywhere, one 联华大厦 tower glowing among the buildings, camera descending toward the streets
shots.sub: 十年，我背熟了这座城市的每一根 K 线。
shots.speaker: 旁白
shots.fx: 城市环境音+低音鼓点进

shots.detail_en: medium shot at the trading hall back door, CH a 22-year-old in a white shirt with his repaired steel watch chain handing over a janitor work badge to the gatekeeper
shots.sub: 扫地的不进大厅。我只要一个能看见大屏的位置。
shots.speaker: 门卫、长

shots.detail_en: wide shot inside the old trading hall, a huge red-green mechanical flip-board screen above a sea of retail traders, CH standing alone in the farthest corner looking up
shots.sub: 父亲的笔记本，第一页只有一句话——盘口会说谎，成交量不会。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: close-up insert of the notebook opening to hand-drawn 1993 candlestick charts, the last page missing one line, recurring prop
medium shot, the big board suddenly flipping from red to green as the crowd erupts in panic and uproar
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: close-up of CH's eyes narrowing as he scans the board, dead calm amid the surrounding panic
shots.speaker: 长

shots.detail_en: rapid triple-cut montage: the flip-board screen / a fierce bald-headed big player / streams of retail traders removing their nameplates and leaving through the door, fragmentary editing rhythm
shots.sub: 恐慌，是庄家最好的烟幕。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: medium shot, MANCANG in a loud floral shirt squeezing through the crowd into the corner, clinging to a pillar with a mournful wailing face
shots.sub: 完了！我全仓啊！全部身家！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: close-up, CH looking at MANCANG then back at the big screen, deadpan expression
shots.speaker: 长、满仓

shots.detail_en: wide shot, the big board violently flipping into a sea of red, the entire crowd roaring in frenzy
shots.speaker: 散户群
shots.fx: 全场轰鸣+主题曲动机首现

shots.detail_en: close-up, MANCANG sliding down the pillar onto the floor, his face shifting from deathly pale to a silly grin
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: medium shot on the second-floor VIP seats, XIONG in a black suit with a red tie and prayer beads lowering his binoculars with a faint smile, dark and imposing presence
close-up of XIONG's wrist slowly twisting the prayer beads one by one, thoughtful and menacing gaze
shots.speaker: 熊

shots.detail_en: following shot after the closing bell, the crowd streaming out, CH the last to leave, turning back to gaze at the empty flip-board screen
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: medium shot, XIONG standing in the doorway shadows backlit, having appeared out of nowhere, ominous silhouette
shots.sub: 小伙子，今天三个点，你是蒙的，还是算的？
shots.speaker: 熊

shots.detail_en: extreme close-up of CH's heirloom steel watch chain, the watch that runs one minute slow
shots.speaker: 长

shots.detail_en: two-shot, XIONG smiling and nodding as he makes way, CH walking past his shoulder
shots.speaker: 熊

shots.detail_en: freeze frame on CH's departing back with the series title 《一路长虹》 fading in over the frame
shots.sub: 熊市没有眼泪。牛市也没有。
shots.speaker: 旁白
